leagues.name: ASAA High School Softball — Division I
leagues.notes: Schools 851+ students; regular-season schedules and standings on ASAA365.com; 2026 state championship June 4–6 in Fairbanks

leagues.name: ASAA High School Softball — Division II
leagues.notes: Schools 1–850 students; schedules and standings on ASAA365.com; shares state championship event with DI (June 4–6 Fairbanks)

leagues.name: Alaska District 1 Little League — Softball
leagues.region: Statewide AK except SE panhandle; 18 member leagues
leagues.notes: Largest LL district in the US; interleague schedules and standings posted on district site; member leagues include Anchorage West, Dimond-West, Palmer, Kenai, Homer, Kodiak, Soldotna, Valdez, and others

leagues.name: Alaska District 2 Little League — Softball
leagues.notes: Covers SE panhandle leagues including Gastineau Channel Little League (Juneau), Ketchikan, Sitka, Petersburg, Wrangell, and Prince of Wales

leagues.name: Interior Girls Softball Association (IGSA) — Recreational Summer League
leagues.notes: 300+ players ages 3–18; also supports local high school softball and indoor winter gym programs; North Star Travel teams for competitive play

leagues.name: Anchorage Sports Association — Middle School Fastpitch Softball
leagues.governingBody: Anchorage Sports Association / Anchorage School District
leagues.notes: Partnership with Anchorage School District and American Legion Baseball; 3 Saturday double-headers; $110 activity fee; open to all ASD middle school students

leagues.name: Anchorage Sports Association — USA Junior Olympic Fastpitch Softball
leagues.governingBody: Anchorage Sports Association / USA Softball of Alaska
leagues.notes: Junior Olympic (JO) club-level fastpitch; managed through ASA Softball Council; teams compete in USA Softball of Alaska sanctioned play
